_note: M-LOADOUT PerkCatalog (docs/spec/loadout.md §1.2). A perk fills a player's SECOND slot instead of a weapon. v1 perks are PASSIVE: pure head-frame tweaks the compiler already knows how to write ($PSET armor, $AMMO + $WEAP ammo/reload tokens, $BMAP alt-reload). `mechanism: slot_frame` rows would be a $WEAP in slot 1 whose effect lives in the VICTIM's $SIR table (game-wide, not per-player) — they stay `hidden` until the emit-side bench proves them. `verified` = effect proven on hardware. Copy is player-facing: no protocol jargon.

perks.name: Body Armor
perks.desc: Start every life with 50 extra armor. Armor soaks hits before your health does — you survive one or two more shots in every fight.

perks.name: Extended Mags
perks.desc: Double the magazine and double the reserve on your primary. Fewer reloads, longer fights, more rounds to burn.

perks.name: Quick Hands
perks.desc: Reload in half the time. Your primary is back in the fight before theirs is.

perks.name: Easy Reload
perks.desc: Press the orange ALT button to reload — no pump needed. For anyone who finds the pull-back reload hard to work.

perks.name: Quick Switch
perks.desc: Draw your second weapon in half the time: the gun's swap delay drops from 0.85 s to 0.43 s.

perks.name: Med Kit
perks.desc: A healing shot for teammates — tag an ally to top up their health.

perks.name: Concussion
perks.desc: A stun burst that jams an enemy's weapon for a few seconds.
